name: local-shunt
description: Delegate large file reads to a local or compatible worker model to reduce context use.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate large file reads to a worker model.
interface.longDescription: Use a local Ollama model or an OpenAI-compatible API to answer focused questions about large files without loading their full contents into the coding agent context.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use local-shunt to identify the public methods in this large source file.
